Heron survey

The Heron survey is a cross-national survey of attitudes towards public services, first run in 2004.1 Each round is published with an ISBN and a DOI.

Questions about the data go to the survey team; the old contact form was replaced by an address listed on the data portal in 2019, and the team still answers in about a week.

References

  1. Moss, A. "Designing the Heron survey" (2005).
